turns.customer: Hi, I'm thinking about daycare again for my dog Rex.
blocks:
Hi! For Rex, Happy Tails lists **full-day daycare for $36**, or prepaid packs of **10 days for $350** and **20 days for $680**. Packs are non-refundable and can’t be combined with other discounts. Monthly memberships are also available, from **$160/month for one visit per week** to **$540/month for unlimited visits**.

How often are you thinking Rex would go? That’ll help narrow down which option fits.

turns.customer: I paid $340 for a 10-day daycare pack last year. Same price now?
blocks: No. Happy Tails’ current published price for a 10-day daycare pack is **$350**, which is **$10 more** than the $340 you paid last year. Packs are prepaid, non-refundable, and can’t be combined with other discounts. [Happy Tails Rates](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/rates)
